text:
Lyla Chen: Morning — quick Day 4 async check-in. TL;DR: mostly unblocked but two small access things and one env quirk.

Lyla Chen: What I did yesterday: finished GitLab onboarding, ran through the quickstart app, and submitted the sample inference PR (WIP). Spent some time on the GPU queue docs and read the infra runbook.

Lyla Chen: Blockers: 1) can't pull base images from the private registry from my laptop (`docker pull registry.redwood.internal/...` fails with 403). 2) my kubeconfig is missing the `dev-team` context so I can't get into the dev cluster to test the deployment.

Lyla Chen: Today: pair with Jonah on the PR patch (pinged him), try the local model runner once I can get the base image, and finish the access checklist. Also will join the 3pm infra sync if there's time.

Jonah K: @Lyla Chen I can pair at 2pm PT. For the registry 403 we usually need a short-lived token from the IDP — ping Priya if the idp-bot didn't auto-issue it.

Priya R: idp-bot should have created a token when you completed SSO. Can you paste the output of `curl -v https://registry.redwood.internal/v2/` (redact headers) so I can see the auth challenge?

Lyla Chen: ok running that now, will paste minimal output.

Lyla Chen: ```
* Connected to registry.redwood.internal (10.20.5.3) port 443 (#0)
> GET /v2/ HTTP/1.1
> Host: registry.redwood.internal
< HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
< content-type: application/json
{ "error": "forbidden" }
```

Priya R: hm looks like your machine didn't pick up the short-lived creds. Did you run `idp login` after the SSO flow?

Lyla Chen: I did earlier but maybe the agent didn't write the file. My `~/.config/idp/creds.json` is empty.

idp-bot: Created new credential bundle for Lyla Chen (expires in 8h). Run `idp refresh --apply` to update local files.

Lyla Chen: ran `idp refresh --apply` and retried `docker pull` — still 403.

Devon (Infra): @Lyla Chen can you check that `DOCKER_CONFIG` isn't pointing at an old creds dir? Also we had a cached credential helper issue on macOS earlier this week — `cat ~/.docker/config.json` and look for the credentialStore field.

Lyla Chen: oh yeah `DOCKER_CONFIG` was set to `/tmp/docker-old` from an experiment. Unset it and retried, `docker pull` now responding with 401 then prompting for token. After `idp refresh` it pulled.

Lyla Chen: registry issue fixed :party_parrot: — thanks Devon/ Priya.

Lyla Chen: Kubeconfig follow-up: when I run `kubectl config get-contexts` I only see `minikube` and `local`. Not `dev-team`.

Priya R: I see your account is missing the `k8s:dev-read` role binding — opened a request with infra access team (ticket #INF-721). ETA ~2 hours. If you need immediate access for the pairing, Devon can create a short-lived role for you.

Devon (Infra): I can grant `dev-team` context for 1 hour. @Lyla Chen do you want that now?

Lyla Chen: yes please for the pairing at 2pm.

Devon (Infra): Done — pushed a temp kubeconfig to your workspace at `~/redwood/temp/kubeconfig-devteam`. Export `KUBECONFIG=~/redwood/temp/kubeconfig-devteam` and `kubectl get pods -n redwood-test` should work.

Lyla Chen: confirmed, can see the pods. Thanks!

Lyla Chen: One small cosmetic thing: my shell prompt shows weird chars after enabling `bash-git-prompt`. Might be $TERM or a font issue. Not blocking but will file a tiny note in #devex.

Jonah K: +1 on the pairing at 2pm PT. I'll review your PR now and leave inline comments. If you want, drop the PR link here and I can annotate while we pair.

Lyla Chen: PR: https://gitlab.redwood/internal/lyla/sample-inference/merge_requests/7 — pinged you in the description for the test bucket creds.

Priya R: Nice job on the PR checklist. For the test bucket you should use `redwood-test-lyla-<team>` — I'll approve the bucket policy once Jonah gives thumbs up on the code.

Lyla Chen: Thanks everyone — marking registry and kube access as resolved for now. Remaining small tasks: attach SSH key to GitLab (will do after pairing), confirm VPN stays connected overnight (had one disconnect earlier), and finish the onboarding quiz.

Jonah K: If the VPN flakes, we usually tell new hires to switch to wired or try the alternate client (`openvpn-alternate`). Also ping @people-ops if access hiccups block required trainings.

Lyla Chen: noted. I'll update the onboarding checklist and circle back if anything else pops up. Appreciate the quick help :thumbsup:

Devon (Infra): Welcome aboard again, Lyla — glad to have you.

Lyla Chen: thanks all!
